Name: Alien Dog Replacement
Author: sedoneybaloney
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QefvwPG.png[/img]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces the vanilla sprite for dog2 with an alien dog
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download the mod file and extract into your mods folder (Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
[/list][b]Notes[/b]
[list]
[*]The icon for dog2 in the character creation screen is altered by this mod and will show the alien dog
[*]The only pet affected is the dog labelled dog2 in the game files, which is the dog pictured below:
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/5V1hO5D.png[/img]
[b]Future Updates[/b][list]
[*]If there is demand, I will expand the alien pet lineup in an update!
[*]If you'd like to see more alien pets, feel free to [u]comment with requests[/u]! I will gladly take suggestions for specific pets and color variations :)
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/YYExLQk.png[/img]
